role: synthetic development screen; not forecasting confirmation or inference certification
episodes_per_day: Poisson(1.5), capped at four, zero-event calendar days retained
paired_loss_difference: gain + shared calendar shock + episode noise; this directly models loss differences, not fitted forecast probabilities
estimand: equal-weight mean paired loss difference across simulated information episodes
oracle: known-DGP conditional variance; design reference only, unavailable on real data
screen_acceptance: in every declared cell: Wilson 95% lower coverage bound >=0.93 and upper two-sided type-I bound <=0.07
gain_power: lower 95% interval bound above zero; separately report with point gain >=0.001, a sensitivity threshold not a V7 adopted utility rule
mde_reference: (normal 0.975 quantile + normal 0.8 quantile) times median known-DGP standard error
limits: Assumed noise scales, not estimated EventX scales
